page_title: BOL 2-0 COM | Bologna v Como 01/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' The resulting set piece from Como is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

90+3' Nico Paz (Como) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the roof of the net but is denied by Lukasz Skorupski, who pulls off a glorious save! The ball is out of play and Como manage to earn a corner.
90+1' Remo Freuler (Bologna) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' Alberto Dossena (Como) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
85' The referee signals a substitution. Fellipe Jack (Como) is brought on as a substitute for Assane Diao.
85' Substitution. Alessio Iovine (Como) replaces Alex Valle.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Nikola Moro will be replaced by Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
83' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to make a change. Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) replaces Benjamin Dominguez.
77' Substitution. Maximo Perrone makes way for Gabriel Strefezza (Como).
73' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

73' Sam Beukema (Bologna) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the bottom right corner. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save. It will be a corner kick for Bologna.
73' Nikola Moro (Bologna) will take a corner kick.

72' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The ball goes behind for a corner. Bologna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
68' Juan Miranda (Bologna) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
66' 2 - 0 It's a goal! Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) bravely launches himself at a cross from Juan Miranda and gives Jean Butez no chance with a close-range bullet header into the roof of the net. 2:0.
65' Assane Diao (Como) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Massimi had an easy-decision to make.
64' Vincenzo Italiano decides to make a substitution. Thijs Dallinga will be replaced by Santiago Castro (Bologna).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Patrick Cutrone trots off the pitch and is replaced by Jonathan Ikone (Como).

61' What a chance that is! Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the right post!
59' Juan Miranda (Bologna) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Jean Butez comes off the line to clear the ball away.

56' Bologna slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
54' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort.
52' Vincenzo Italiano has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) replacing Dan Ndoye.
51' The opposition back off Assane Diao (Como) and he lashes in a shot from the edge of the box that just flies a whisker wide of the left post. Unlucky!
47' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
46' The game is over for Maxence Caqueret. Lucas Da Cunha (Como) comes on for the second half.
46' Vincenzo Italiano has made a change at the break. Juan Miranda (Bologna) has come on in place of Charalampos Lykogiannis.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
45+1' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Luca Massimi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Maxence Caqueret (Como) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
38' Alieu Fadera (Como) is sent off for dissent after saying something out of turn to the referee!
38' The main referee, Luca Massimi, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Alieu Fadera (Como) is given a yellow card for dissent.
38' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) latches onto a pass inside the box, steps inside his marker and smacks a shot against the crossbar.
36' Assane Diao (Como) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
35' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) covers his face with his hands after wasting a promising chance. He takes the rebound on the edge of the box but blazes the ball high over the crossbar.
35' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
34' Luca Massimi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Yannik Engelhardt (Como). Free kick. Bologna will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
31' Nico Paz (Como) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
30' Maximo Perrone (Como) will deliver the corner kick.
30' Assane Diao (Como) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
29' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Como, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
29' The whistle is blown for an infringement and Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) receives a yellow card!
25' 1 - 0 Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) wins the ball inside the box from the free kick and fires a superb strike into the top right corner. The goalkeeper was helpless.
24' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
23' Nikola Moro (Bologna) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
22' Luca Massimi blows the whistle, Assane Diao (Como) is penalised for a foul. That's a free kick to Bologna.
22' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) picks up a long through ball, but Jean Butez deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
21' Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) is adjudged offside.
19' Benjamin Dominguez (Bologna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
17' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
15' A cross arrives in the goalmouth from the resulting corner kick. Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) outjumps the defence, but his promising header bounces away off the bar!
14' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) prepares to take a corner kick.
14' Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Bologna have a corner.
12' Alieu Fadera (Como) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lukasz Skorupski intercepts the ball.
10' Remo Freuler (Bologna) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
9' Maximo Perrone (Como) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
8' Patrick Cutrone (Como) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
7' Jens Odgaard (Bologna) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
3' The resulting corner from Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) is cleared by the defence.

2' Remo Freuler (Bologna) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Jean Butez to dive and make a save. The ball goes out of play. Bologna are awarded a corner kick.
2' Alberto Dossena (Como) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' Luca Massimi blows his whistle after Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Como will kick-off.
Luca Massimi will officiate today.
